data.name: Azmara
data.gender_notes: Azmara is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Azmara is derived from the Arabic word 'azm' which means determination, resolution, and steadfastness. In Islamic culture, this name is often given to girls as a symbol of their strong character and unwavering commitment to their beliefs and values. The name Azmara carries the meaning “Steadfastness, determination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azmara usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfastness, determination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to stay steadfast in faith and purpose
data.etymology: Azmara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfastness, determination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azmara total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
